Read input: read_pointer_combined.v · Open raw
module read_pointer(
    rptr, fifo_rd, rd, fifo_empty, clk, rst_n
);

  input rd, fifo_empty, clk, rst_n;
  output[4:0] rptr;
  output fifo_rd;
  reg[4:0] rptr;

  assign fifo_rd = (~fifo_empty) & rd;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if(~rst_n)
        rptr <= 5'b00000;
    else if(fifo_rd)
        rptr <= rptr + 5'b00001;
  end

endmodule
